title: Performance scorecards engine
story: As the PMO I get per-agent, per-tier and per-team scorecards with composite score, low-performer flags and diagnoses so poor configurations are fixed.
acceptance: org/scorecards.mjs exports pure functions (agentScorecards, teamScorecards, compositeScore, diagnose, buildScorecards) plus a CLI entry: node org/scorecards.mjs [--sprint n] writes org/scorecards/latest.json and org/scorecards/sprint-<n>.json

Each scorecard row has ticketsDone, points, firstPassAcceptance, reworkRate, defects, hoursPerPoint vs company median, costPerPoint, composite, lowPerformer, lowConfidence (true when <3 tickets), diagnosis
Composite follows the config formula exactly; low performer = bottom 10% composite or below target two sprints running; lowConfidence rows are never flagged as actionable
Diagnosis heuristics: points>8 with rework => oversized task; cost per point > 2x median => wrong tier; others documented in code
Test file tests/unit/org/scorecards.test.mjs passes with node --test using in-test fixtures, including <3 tickets, zero-ticket and zero-points edge cases, no division by zero or NaN
Running the CLI on the real board produces valid JSON files in org/scorecards/
brief: Build org/scorecards.mjs. Input: tickets from org/board/tickets (use listTickets from org/fabric.mjs in the CLI path only; pure functions take arrays so tests use fixtures). Only status done tickets count. Ticket fields: owner, tier, team, points, sprint, startedAt/doneAt (hours = doneAt-startedAt), spend.usd, review.firstPass, review.reworkCount, review.escapedDefects. Group by owner id (key 'owner' and also by 'owner+tier' configuration) and by team. Metrics: firstPassAcceptance = share with review.firstPass; reworkRate = share with reworkCount>0; defects = sum escapedDefects / tickets, capped 0..1 for composite; estimateAccuracy = clamp(1 - |hoursPerPoint/medianHoursPerPoint - 1|, 0, 1); costEfficiency = clamp(medianCostPerPoint/costPerPoint,0,1), 1 when no data. Median is over all done tickets. Composite: 0.35*firstPass + 0.2*(1-rework) + 0.2*estimateAccuracy + 0.15*costEfficiency + 0.1*(1-defects). Low performer: bottom 10% composite among rows with >=3 tickets, or composite below the target two sprints running (read earlier org/scorecards/sprint-<n>.json if present, tolerate absence). Output shape (shared with the dashboard ticket S1-PMO-02, do not change): {sprint, generatedAt, medians:{hoursPerPoint,costPerPoint}, agents:[row], configs:[row], teams:[row]} where row = {key, owner?, tier?, team?, ticketsDone, points, firstPassAcceptance, reworkRate, defects, hoursPerPoint, costPerPoint, composite, lowPerformer, lowConfidence, diagnosis:[string]}. Round to 3 decimals. Pitfalls: missing spend or timestamps, deterministic ordering (sort by key), do not touch other files. Do not git commit; edit nothing outside your paths. Run: node --test --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning tests/unit/org/scorecards.test.mjs.

verdicts.reason: All criteria met: 9 tests pass, CLI on real board writes valid JSON with all row fields, composite/low-performer rules match config, diagnosis heuristics present
